title: Filigreed Feywild Bell
summary: Ring the bell and ask Dolly Thrice for party-wide protection from the Shadow Curse.

fields.Effect: Pixie Blessing protects from the Shadow Curse, including its deepest areas. Changing regions can remove it. Ring the bell and ask again to restore it.
fields.Acquisition: Receive it when freeing Dolly Thrice from Kar’niss’s Moonlantern.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence.
